research_question: Does the reconstructible XAUUSD EMA9/21 cross -> later EMA9 touch -> later touch-candle break -> later completed close beyond the frozen pre-cross 10-bar swing generate positive frozen 30-second executable persistence with usable Stage-A supply?

public_source.name: TradingView — XAUUSD Session 9EMA Last-Cross + Touch + Enter/R.Enter
public_source.disclosed_logic: EMA9/21 cross sets bias; freeze prior 10-bar swing excluding cross bar; wait for EMA9 touch; then break touch candle; then completed close beyond frozen swing; opposite cross resets; one ENTER per cross.

causal_reconstruction.rule: Every stage transition must occur on a later completed bar than the prior transition; this avoids retrospective intrabar ordering.

gate.pass_action: advance best preregistered survivor to independent later-January validation
